ctx.x: But anyhow, I said, 'Well, what about my brother-in-law, Russell?' You know, so he said, 'Have him to come down. I've got a gig New Years Eve, and have him to come down and sit in.' So he come down and sat in, so he kept him, you know.
Oh. How long did Russell stay with the band?
